description: `test-genie` registers a new `phase_ui_health` (after `phase_contracts`) that shells out to `ui-health validate scenario <name> --json` and surfaces findings as Observations.

requirements.description: `test-genie` must register a new phase named `phase_ui_health` that executes after `phase_contracts`. This phase must shell out to `ui-health validate scenario <name> --json`, parse the returned Report JSON, and surface each Finding as a test-genie Observation with appropriate severity and metadata mapping.
requirements.title: test-genie phase_ui_health Integration Phase

validation.notes: `phase_ui_health` is registered in test-genie's phase registry after `phase_contracts`
Phase correctly invokes `ui-health validate scenario <name> --json` as a subprocess
Each Finding in the Report JSON is mapped to a test-genie Observation with type, message, and severity fields
Phase passes when Report contains zero Findings
Phase fails when Report contains one or more Findings of sufficient severity
Run test-genie on a scenario with known manifest violations and confirm Observations appear in test-genie output corresponding to each Finding
Run test-genie on a clean scenario and confirm phase_ui_health produces zero Observations and phase result is PASS
Confirm phase execution order: phase_contracts completes before phase_ui_health starts
phase_ui_health adds no more than 10 seconds overhead per scenario to the test-genie pipeline
UI health violations are surfaced in the same test-genie report as contract violations, giving developers a unified quality signal

title: test-genie phase_ui_health integration
